thread:
alex: Quick heads-up — we have a compressed SOC2 + ISO evidence window next week (Mon–Wed). To avoid a pile-up in uploads and reviewer queues we’re running staggered upload lanes by team name. Please read and ack if you’re an evidence owner. :wave:

alex: Staggered lanes:
- Mon: Teams A–L
- Tue: Teams M–Z
- Wed: Contractors / 3rd-party integrators / exception cases

alex: Owners are flagged in the tracker (column: *Evidence Owner*). Please upload artifacts to the team folder and add the checklist entry. Link: https://redwood-internal.example/evidence-tracker (view-only for most; edit for owners).

alex: Quick upload rules:
- Use the canonical path: s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/2026/{team}/
- Filename pattern: {control}_{team}_{YYYYMMDD}_{brief}.pdf
- Redact PII before upload. If you need redaction help tag @lisa

maria: On redaction — do we have a simple checklist? I can’t open the redaction tool from home network during travel.

lisa: Yes — small checklist in the tracker (col: Redaction Steps). If you can’t access the tool, ping me and I’ll do a one-off redaction for you. Also: private deployments artifacts need the extra HSM proof; see note in the tracker.

jordan: I’m the owner for infra — taking Mon. Will post when upload is complete.

sam: Hey — contractors: do we need signed POAs from external vendors now or is that handled separately?

alex: Good q — contractors with access to customer data need a signed POA and a mapper doc. If you’re responsible for contractors, please upload the POA to the contractor folder and mark the checklist as "POA uploaded". If you run into gaps, escalate to me and we’ll route to legal.

compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled: Upload window opens Mon 09:00 PT. Owners with no upload by 18:00 PT will get an automated nudge.

maria: Can we get an exceptions form link? Some teams have multi-repo traces that will take longer.

alex: Exceptions form: https://redwood-internal.example/forms/evidence-exception. Short turnaround: approvals only for documented blockers. If you submit, put the ticket ID in the tracker.

devex-bot: Office hours: Mon 10:00–12:00 PT (upload clinic), Tue 14:00–16:00 PT (redaction + HSM help). Join: https://meet.example/comp-office-hours

sam: Will the SRE reviewers be cross-team or per-lane?

alex: Reviewers will be split across lanes to speed it up. We’ve paired SRE + Security reviewers for private deployment artifacts.

lisa: One more thing — if your artifacts include screenshots with internal IPs, add a note in the checklist so reviewers know it’s expected.

jordan: Uploaded infra folder at 2026-04-06 11:07 PT. Marking checklist done.

maria: Acked. I’ll triage our repos for redaction tonight.

alex: Thanks all. Final ask: owners — please confirm in the tracker after upload and flag any lingering blockers by Tue 12:00 PT. If you need help, DM me or @lisa. :thumbsup:
